verdict.rationale: Data portability and exit is a fair question for an agent framework, because sessions, artifacts and state could be exported. However, the pack documents no data-export capability or open export formats. Related portability signals, such as code-first agents, model swapping and container packaging that runs anywhere, are adjacent features and do not count as exporting user data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
